assessment.diversity_evidence: All stories share the central problem of a shivering animal stranded on a high ledge and end with it wrapped in a warm blanket. Most use the same bread-in-basket-and-rope rescue (for example, s000014 and s000041); only s000034, s000002, s000039, and s000035 use a ladder instead. Character and animal substitutions do not change the plot, and the ladder branch is a small causal variation. These sampled stories are highly similar, without establishing the diversity of the full generator.

plot_groups.summary: A child shares bread to coax a frightened animal from a high ledge into a rope-lowered basket, then brings it inside and wraps it warmly.
A child steadies a ladder while an adult climbs up and lifts the stranded animal down, then the child brings it inside and wraps it warmly.
